objective: Implement and verify a deterministic, shadow-only cross-market precursor system that turns Stock Terminal's canonical international-tech, de-duplicated 2330/0050 anchor, fixed memory baskets, breadth/liquidity and flow/derivatives evidence into persistent, readable, de-duplicated downside/upside transition alerts without granting trading authority to AI or the signal layer.

inScope: evaluate five independent canonical evidence domains and four named precursor signals
de-duplicate 2330 and 0050 through an explicit residual when a usable weight exists and fail closed otherwise
persist observation, watch, armed, confirmed, active, conflict, recovery and invalidation transitions in SQLite
expose read-only signal state/history APIs through the private Web allow-list
render a readable Decision panel and optional transition-only Telegram/email/webhook delivery
add formula, lifecycle, integration, build, private-Web and responsive UI verification
outOfScope: automatic trading, portfolio mutation, direct buy/sell signals or leverage recommendations
allowing the indicator to overwrite DecisionContext regime, confidence, key levels or Action Envelope
claiming signal strength is probability or a validated forecast
adding paid data providers, credentials, new public exposure, commit, push or deployment
discarding, staging or rewriting unrelated runtime data changes

the existing overnight/intraday fixed memory baskets are reusable as a quality-gated evidence domain
the first release is observational shadow evidence and requires prospective history before authority can increase
TSM ADR is context only until point-in-time FX/parity data is available

permissions: modify scoped local project source, tests and loop state
run deterministic local tests, builds and read-only runtime/browser verification
availableResources: local repository and existing canonical Pulse, DecisionContext and Evidence Ledger seams
existing memory taxonomy and overnight/intraday fixed baskets
existing Python, JavaScript, Private Web and build verification infrastructure
excludedResources: repository commit, push, release promotion and production deployment without a later explicit approval
new external AI review; the previously verified multi-provider design is treated as frozen input
credentials, private brokerage data, personal holdings and private access tokens
new paid market-data adapters or expanded network exposure

loopHistory.summary: Implemented a deterministic shadow-only cross-market precursor system with de-duplicated anchors, persistent lifecycle transitions, canonical DecisionContext evidence, read-only APIs, opt-in transition delivery and a responsive Decision radar.
residualRisks: Signal strength is a bounded evidence score, not a probability or prospectively validated forecast.
The memory-cycle domain remains unavailable when the fixed-basket cache is missing or stale; the engine deliberately degrades instead of imputing direction.
External alerts remain disabled until explicitly enabled and production evaluation still requires prospective false-positive, lead-time and regime-drift history.

loopHistory.summary: Delivered the first TXO structure vertical slice with official expiry-scoped observations, auditable direction-neutral Greeks, explicit signed-GEX scenarios, DecisionContext evidence, default-collapsed UI and safe stale fallback.
residualRisks: Public OI does not disclose dealer inventory direction, so Signed GEX and Flip remain scenario research only.
End-of-day TAIFEX data can lag live trading and is labeled with trade date and session.
Current scenario flip band is low-stability and must not be promoted to a single deterministic level.

loopHistory.summary: Added direction-neutral OI Vega density, versioned scenario Signed VEX and bounded same-expiry history, then integrated them into the canonical DecisionContext, Decision UI, evidence ledger and privacy-safe distribution.
residualRisks: Public OI still does not reveal dealer direction, so Signed GEX/VEX remain scenario outputs rather than observed exposure.
History needs two successful day-end snapshots of the exact same expiry before a change comparison is available.
Short-dated put-call parity carry can annualize to extreme values and remains visibly warned instead of silently normalized.

loopHistory.summary: Completed an evidence-backed full architecture and code review without changing product behavior. The review documents current and target architecture, six open P1 and six P2 findings, strengths, verification results, remediation order and measurable acceptance gates.
residualRisks: The product remains conditional because six verified P1 findings require implementation; completing the review does not close those product risks.
The canonical Python unittest suite currently exits with three order-dependent import errors and does not collect 27 module-level test functions.
Live-provider market-session validation and long-running browser memory/listener profiling were outside this read-only review.

loopHistory.summary: Closed ARC-001 through ARC-012 with safe local HTTP boundaries, atomic recoverable persistence, protected secret migration, bounded request deadlines, canonical cross-platform CI, market-time and market-identity contracts, deterministic share builds, incremental AppKernel/service seams and a readable Decision Center.
residualRisks: server/server.py and the generated single-page shell remain large compatibility surfaces; new work must use the introduced route/service/repository and AppKernel seams instead of expanding them directly.
Public market providers can still be delayed or unavailable; the product now exposes fresh/delayed/stale/unknown outcomes instead of inventing freshness.
Windows secret storage prefers current-user DPAPI but falls back to machine-scope DPAPI in restricted service contexts; both avoid plaintext, while current-user scope remains preferred.
Provider values without a timezone-aware market timestamp remain sourceStatus=unknown and must not be presented as live.
Unrelated refreshed CSV files in the dirty worktree retain existing CRLF/trailing-whitespace noise; scoped source-code diff checks pass and the deterministic archive normalizes packaged files.

loopHistory.summary: Re-read and independently challenged all five current Taiwan dynamic-leverage articles, traced the Part 2/3 corrections and Part 4 negative out-of-sample result, identified current Exposure Lab authority and benchmark conflicts, and produced an implementation-ready indicator, contract, UI and verification design without promoting research into a trade signal.
residualRisks: Taiwan 50 point-in-time component weights and a canonical total-return history still need a stable source contract.
The author's 52-week mean-reversion volatility forecast is not fully specified and must not be presented as reproduced by Stock Terminal.
Forward EPS, fair P/E, other-component growth, incremental product cost and user leverage caps remain assumptions with material model risk.
The full monthly fundamental core has not yet passed Stock Terminal point-in-time nested walk-forward or a prospective shadow cycle.

loopHistory.summary: Implemented Exposure Lab v3 with a frozen monthly core, monitor-only weekly health, benchmark-isolated volatility, official Taiwan 50 price/total-return history, TSMC EPS evidence layers, daily-leverage product mechanics, selected-benchmark action constraints, progressive Decision UI and expanded Evidence Ledger; then passed full backend, frontend, live HTTP, build and privacy gates.
residualRisks: Taiwan 50 and TAIEX TSMC weights remain dated external research snapshots rather than a point-in-time official constituent-weight history.
The author 52-week volatility model is not fully specified; ST labels and uses a transparent max(RV252, rolling three-year median) proxy instead of claiming reproduction.
The Part 4 out-of-sample result remains external_research with stReproduced=false; the full monthly fundamental core has not passed ST nested walk-forward or a prospective monthly shadow cycle.
Forward EPS, fair P/E, non-TSMC growth, payout, product incremental cost and policy caps remain explicit assumptions and must be reviewed on their stated cadence.

loopHistory.summary: Eliminated three independent intraday false-volume paths: normalized MIS lots and Yahoo shares behind one explicit contract, preserved fresh MIS volume during Yahoo price fallback, replaced ad-hoc cumulative subtraction with a deterministic source-aware tracker, and made synthetic and closing-auction minute allocation fail closed; then passed backend, frontend, build, live API and Chrome gates.
residualRisks: Volume accumulated during an unobserved multi-minute gap is intentionally omitted from minute allocation until authoritative minute history becomes available; Stock Terminal no longer invents a distribution.
Yahoo fallback prices may be delayed and are now labeled as backup rather than drawn at the current minute; provider latency remains external.
Closing-auction remainder backfill requires an explicit intradayVolumeComplete attestation, so current Yahoo payloads fail closed instead of guessing the final bucket.
TWSE MIS availability and timestamp quality remain provider dependencies, while source transitions and resets are persisted through the existing bounded UI diagnostic trace.

loopHistory.summary: Created a privacy-clean exact release commit, rebuilt and tested it outside the worktree, promoted it atomically, started the isolated Private Web host and passed local plus Tailscale HTTPS authentication, authorization, availability and deployed-volume contract gates.
residualRisks: The isolated host is a local long-running process; a Windows reboot still requires START_PRIVATE_WEB_HOST.cmd unless a separately approved startup task is configured.
Tailscale HTTPS availability remains dependent on the local machine, Tailscale service and existing Serve/Funnel configuration.
The active application release is 4f89131e5585; the later repository-only verification record does not change served application behavior.

loopHistory.summary: Implemented the Overnight × Intraday memory-theme vertical slice as deterministic shadow research: consistently adjusted Open/Close, exact return identity, 20/60-session structure, same-market residual comparison, TW/US basket quorum, cache-only GET, bounded fixed-universe refresh, canonical DecisionData attachment, readable Decision panel and auditable Evidence Ledger integration.
residualRisks: Yahoo daily chart data remains a public-provider dependency and is not an official institutional-flow feed; opening repricing must not be described as observed smart-money activity.
The current fixed memory baskets and thresholds are research definitions, not validated portfolio signals; prospective history is required before considering any authority increase.
Benchmark-relative values are display-only in v1 because high-beta residual interpretation requires further stability testing across market regimes.

The repository-wide unittest discovery runner retains pre-existing test import-order debt, and the share preflight intentionally rejects the new untracked files until a later explicit Git commit; targeted product Gates pass.
